recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is for FHIR core. If the SMART on FHIR Python client listing needs maintenance, update the Confluence Open Source Implementations page or related tools registry rather than adding a downloads-page row.
issue_request: FHIR-22720 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for R5 and asked to add https://github.com/smart-on-fhir/client-py to the downloads page Reference Implementations section.
initial_application: Commit cc0ca1fe0e1047ed9b49ed5721a6072df3b9e26b added a Python row for smart-on-fhir/client-py to source/downloads.html, and merge commit 1295f5847a brought it into the main source history. The Jira comment also noted the source change appeared applied but not yet published.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-30088 resolved the same Python/reference implementation area by moving reference implementation and library listings to the HL7 Confluence Open Source Implementations page; FHIR-I minutes on 2021-02-22 recorded the same 12-0-0 direction. FHIR-30088 commit f575ef6b27e6bc5fc01db942c9cf8d00f50099f2 removed the local downloads Reference Implementations rows, including Python. FHIR-31735 later reinforced moving mutable tools/reference implementation information to Confluence. Current source/downloads.html links to the FHIR Tools Registry, and source/implsupport-module.html links reference implementation libraries to Open Source Implementations.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring a direct smart-on-fhir/client-py row in source/downloads.html would undo the later work-group decision to keep mutable implementation/library inventories out of the core specification source.
